mentions.name: Personalized 'everything' app
mentions.description: A personalized 'everything app' that replaces scattered personal scripts with one unified system. It starts with an Android home screen and widget sync to a server/desktop, so calendar notifications appear on desktop first and escalate to mobile, and it can also turn the phone into a mousepad for controlling a projector from bed.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Instead of building scrips here and there I'm attempting my own everything app. Lets see if that's a good idea :).

Starting with android home screen and widget sync to server/desktop. So e.g. calendar notifications happen desktop first, then escalate to mobile etc. Also phone as mousepad (for using my projector from bed).
